blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: Drop the plugin system from this change. The Why ("Accountants copy invoices one by one into their spreadsheet at the end of each month.") is met by a single CSV route; no PDF, XLSX, XML or JSON export is requested. Replace design.md "Decision: Exports go through a plugin registry" with a plain CSV renderer (the rejected alternative "a single CSV function (not extensible)" is the one the Why supports — extensibility is not a stated need), remove task 1.2 (`npm test -- registry`), and remove `src/export/plugins/` from Impact. The registry also adds a start-up module-discovery step whose only consumer is the CSV format; the "No plugin" scenario even describes a state (no CSV) the route `GET /invoices.csv` could not be in.
findings.title: Plugin system for future export formats nobody asked for

findings.evidence: The settings page SHALL let a user choose their preferred export format among the installed plugins.
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Users choose their export format
findings.recommendation: Remove this requirement, its scenarios, task 2.1, the What Changes bullet "A settings page where each user picks their preferred export format." and `web/src/settings/` from Impact. With CSV as the only format and an endpoint named `/invoices.csv`, a preference has nothing to choose between; the scenario "WHEN a user picks CSV THEN exports use CSV" cannot fail and so verifies nothing, and nothing says where the preference is stored (it would need a new per-user column the plan does not mention). The release note ("Added: Export a month's invoices as CSV.") does not mention it either. If a format preference is wanted later, it belongs in the change that adds a second format.
findings.title: Settings page for a preferred export format nobody asked for

findings.recommendation: The plan adds `GET /invoices.csv`, a new endpoint that exports a month's invoices with their customer names in bulk, and changes the settings page (`web/src/settings/` in Impact). No spec scenario says who may call the export (no unauthorized case), and `src/server.ts` today only has `/health`, so no existing guard covers it. Tick `security` and `personal-data` so their experts review the endpoint's access control and the bulk export of customer data; tick `user-interface` if the settings page stays in scope (see R-skeptic-2), otherwise leave it unticked with that reason on its line.
findings.title: Domains touched by the plan are all unticked without a reason
